data.title: Arabian Hills Estate
data.about:
Welcome to Arabian Hills Estate by DECA, where the essence of your dreams finds its home. Positioned to reign as the most coveted community across the UAE, Arabian Hills Estate beckons with a luxurious ensemble of mansion plots nestled within its expansive 244 Million sq.ft Lagoon Community adorned with a Polo Club & Equestrian center. Here, amid this verdant oasis, you'll not just build your dream home, but curate your ultimate lifestyle within a vibrant community ambiance.

Discover a realm of exceptional amenities catering to every facet of refined living – from world-class equestrian facilities to crystalline swimmable lagoons, from upscale shopping arcades to opulent resorts. Each detail of Arabian Hills Estate is meticulously crafted to elevate your living experience to unparalleled heights.

Immerse yourself in the unparalleled ambiance, where lush greenery merges with the cerulean hues of nature, offering an oasis of serenity amidst the bustle of urban life. Here, every moment is an opportunity for adventure, every experience a testament to the vitality of living fully.

Step into a world where possibilities abound and the finest expressions of lifestyle await. Arabian Hills Estate by Deca stands as a testament to luxury living, inviting you to indulge in an unparalleled experience where dreams come alive.

location_tile.title: A Tranquil Living Environment Away from the Hustle and Bustle of Urban Areas
location_tile.heading: LOCATION
location_tile.description:
Escape to Arabian Hills Estate, nestled in the heart of the UAE's serene oasis of Al Faqaa. Embrace the perfect balance of tranquility and excitement, with easy access to major international airports and all the attractions the Emirates have to offer. Located along the Dubai-Al Ain Road, Al Faqa serves as a pivotal link between bustling Dubai and vibrant Abu Dhabi, offering a peaceful haven amidst its sweeping desert landscapes. Here, amidst picturesque dunes, indulge in outdoor adventures like desert safaris and camping, immersing yourself in the natural beauty of the region.

  • Outlet Mall 24 Minutes
  • Silicon Oasis 27 Minutes
  • Silicon Central Mall 27 Minutes
  • Dubai Mall 40 Minutes
  • Rashid Hospital 42 Minutes
